{"notes": "VISIT 3 (5:15). Both body lines are now dark (connected) and run into the tail. They cross at about x=24, and the fin lines continue past it to the upper right (hands at x=30, y=5.6) and lower right (hands at x=27, y=13). The nose joint at the start is intact. The back edge has not been started. The two fin tips are still open and not joined. The pale stray run (about 4 dominoes near x=7-8) is still there. It touches nothing, so it isn't blocking, but it hasn't been lifted. Time is tight.

LEO: Reported the top run landed at the tail, and the picture backs that up. He took the bottom fin, and his hands at the lower fin tip match what he said. He gave clear delegation and said he'd check the whole run. Strong collaboration and execution. Attribution of the top run is still provisional.

TOM: The bottom body now reaches the tail, which fits his earlier takeover. His hands weren't visible this visit, so I can't confirm he placed the last stretch. He was told to finish it and it is finished. Solid, reliable execution. He spoke less this time.

PRIYA: Her status was accurate. She took the top tail edge, and her hands are at the upper fin tip, matching her words. She delegated clearly and kept the team coordinated. She still hasn't visibly inspected joints. Back edge pending. Leadership is strong.

MAYA: Third visit with no visible hands and no words. She ignored direct requests from Priya (bottom tail edge) and Leo (back edge, lift the stray). I have no evidence she built anything, and I can't prove idleness. If nothing from her shows by the end, rate her low on impact and collaboration, and ask her privately.

NEXT: Check that the back edge closes the fins, that the stray is lifted, and that the final chain is fully connected."}
